script: LeBron James is so old that Terrence Jackson has now graduated high school. LeBron is so old, he's closer to the age of Michael Jordan than he is to Cooper Flag. He is 7,987 days younger than Jordan, but 8,026 stays older than Cooper Flag. LeBron James is so old his old head coach was Brendan Malone, who was born in 1935, making him older than the entire NBA itself. He was the head coach of the Cavaliers in 2005. LeBron James is so old he played during the hand checking era as that became illegal in 2005, so he could have very well played in Jordan's era of defense, because he literally did and average 21 points per game with hand checking. LeBron James is so old, three players of his draft class of '03 are already in the Hall of Fame and fully retired. Chris Bosh, Dwyane Wade, and Carmelo Anthony, all of which were once his teammates at some point of his career. LeBron James is so old, it's pretty common knowledge that he was teammates with his own son, Bronny James. But did you know Bronny was born during LeBron's second NBA season, not before he entered the NBA?
what_makes_it_work: Absurd historical comparisons that make LeBron sound impossibly ancient
Fast-paced blending of custom animations, memes, and real NBA clips
Comedic timing and energetic narration delivering punchlines quickly
